guard: Version-correct, read-only compiled fork and migration inspection with unchanged recorded pins and explicit worker snapshots.

mutations.name: compiled fork planning falls back to the version-1 interpreter
mutations.expectRed: a broker-recorded version-2 run can plan a fork without changing its pins
mutations.cell: a broker-recorded version-2 run can plan a fork without changing its pins

mutations.name: compiled migration falls back to the version-1 interpreter
mutations.expectRed: a broker-recorded version-2 run can be inspected for migration
mutations.cell: a broker-recorded version-2 run can be inspected for migration

mutations.name: worker inspection does not enter settled scopes
mutations.expectRed: compiled nested cut stops before its frontier and excludes later history
mutations.cell: compiled nested cut stops before its frontier and excludes later history

mutations.name: engine host drops the inspection migration option
mutations.expectRed: compiled nested cut stops before its frontier and excludes later history
mutations.cell: compiled nested cut stops before its frontier and excludes later history

mutations.name: engine effect context drops the inspection migration option
mutations.expectRed: compiled nested cut stops before its frontier and excludes later history
mutations.cell: compiled nested cut stops before its frontier and excludes later history

mutations.name: cut lookup consumes the cut key before stopping
mutations.replace: if (step === this.cutAt) { super.lookup(key, inputHash); this.halt("cut", step); }
mutations.expectRed: a broker-recorded version-2 run can plan a fork without changing its pins
mutations.cell: a broker-recorded version-2 run can plan a fork without changing its pins

mutations.name: finally blocks can consume entries after the latched cut
mutations.expectRed: compiled finalized cut stops before its frontier and excludes later history
mutations.cell: compiled finalized cut stops before its frontier and excludes later history

mutations.name: inspection completion forgets a stop suppressed by finally return
mutations.find:
if (seam.journal instanceof InspectionJournal && seam.journal.stop !== undefined)
      throw seam.journal.stop;
mutations.replace:
if (false && seam.journal instanceof InspectionJournal && seam.journal.stop !== undefined)
      throw seam.journal.stop;
mutations.expectRed: compiled finally-return cut stops before its frontier and excludes later history
mutations.cell: compiled finally-return cut stops before its frontier and excludes later history

mutations.name: pending effects are not treated as an inspection frontier
mutations.expectRed: compiled inspection stops at a pending effect without resuming or settling it
mutations.cell: compiled inspection stops at a pending effect without resuming or settling it

mutations.name: inspection failure drops the orphan snapshot
mutations.expectRed: a broker-recorded version-2 run can plan a fork without changing its pins
mutations.cell: a broker-recorded version-2 run can plan a fork without changing its pins

mutations.name: completed inspection reports no removed history
mutations.expectRed: compiled migration reports only the removed recorded effect
mutations.cell: compiled migration reports only the removed recorded effect

mutations.name: worker divergence serialization drops the recorded hash
mutations.expectRed: compiled migration retains the divergence step and both input hashes
mutations.cell: compiled migration retains the divergence step and both input hashes

mutations.name: missing branch failure is flattened into a generic program error
mutations.find: case "missing-branch": error = new ScopeBranchMissing(exit.step, exit.scope, exit.missing, exit.recorded, exit.source); break;
mutations.replace: case "missing-branch": error = Object.assign(new Error("missing branch"), { code: "L5022" }); break;
mutations.expectRed: compiled migration preserves a missing recorded branch refusal
mutations.cell: compiled migration preserves a missing recorded branch refusal
